stories.title: My New Friend
stories.text: Adam is a new student at school. He feels shy because he does not know anyone. During the break, he sits alone under a tree. A boy named Tom comes and says, Hello! Would you like to play with me? Adam smiles and says, Yes, thank you! They play football together. At the end of the day, Adam feels happy because he has made a new friend.

exercises.question: What is Adam?
exercises.explanation: The story says Adam is a new student at school.

exercises.question: Where does Adam sit during the break?
exercises.explanation: Adam sits alone under a tree during the break.

exercises.question: Tom invites Adam to play.
exercises.explanation: Tom asks Adam if he would like to play with him.

exercises.question: How does Adam feel at the end of the day?
exercises.explanation: Adam is happy because he has made a new friend.

stories.title: أَمَانَةُ سَالِمٍ
stories.text: كَانَ سَالِمٌ يَعُودُ مِنَ الْمَدْرَسَةِ عِنْدَمَا وَجَدَ مِحْفَظَةً صَغِيرَةً عَلَى الرَّصِيفِ. فَتَحَهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا بَعْضَ النُّقُودِ وَبِطَاقَةً تَحْمِلُ اسْمَ صَاحِبِهَا. فَكَّرَ سَالِمٌ فِي الطَّرِيقَةِ الْمُنَاسِبَةِ لِإِعَادَةِ الْمِحْفَظَةِ. ذَهَبَ إِلَى أَقْرَبِ مَرْكَزٍ لِلشُّرْطَةِ وَسَلَّمَهَا إِلَى الْمُوَظَّفِ. بَعْدَ وَقْتٍ قَصِيرٍ، وَصَلَ صَاحِبُ الْمِحْفَظَةِ وَاسْتَعَادَهَا. شَكَرَ سَالِمًا عَلَى أَمَانَتِهِ، وَشَعَرَ سَالِمٌ بِالسَّعَادَةِ لِأَنَّهُ فَعَلَ الصَّوَابَ.

exercises.question: أَيْنَ وَجَدَ سَالِمٌ الْمِحْفَظَةَ؟
exercises.explanation: وَجَدَ سَالِمٌ الْمِحْفَظَةَ عَلَى الرَّصِيفِ وَهُوَ عَائِدٌ مِنَ الْمَدْرَسَةِ.

exercises.question: مَاذَا وَجَدَ سَالِمٌ دَاخِلَ الْمِحْفَظَةِ؟
exercises.explanation: احْتَوَتِ الْمِحْفَظَةُ عَلَى بَعْضِ النُّقُودِ وَبِطَاقَةٍ تَحْمِلُ اسْمَ صَاحِبِهَا.

exercises.question: احْتَفَظَ سَالِمٌ بِالْمِحْفَظَةِ وَنُقُودِهَا.
exercises.explanation: سَلَّمَ سَالِمٌ الْمِحْفَظَةَ إِلَى مَرْكَزِ الشُّرْطَةِ.

exercises.question: مَا الصِّفَةُ الَّتِي تَمَيَّزَ بِهَا سَالِمٌ؟
exercises.explanation: أَعَادَ سَالِمٌ الْمِحْفَظَةَ إِلَى صَاحِبِهَا وَلَمْ يَأْخُذْ مَا فِيهَا.

image.alt: طَالِبٌ يُسَلِّمُ مِحْفَظَةً مَفْقُودَةً إِلَى مُوَظَّفٍ فِي مَرْكَزِ الشُّرْطَةِ

stories.title: The Broken Bicycle
stories.text: One Saturday morning, Jack decides to ride his bicycle to the park. He puts on his helmet and checks the tires. On the way, he hears a strange sound. He stops and discovers that the bicycle chain has come off. Jack does not know how to fix it. An older man nearby notices the problem and offers to help. He shows Jack how to put the chain back in place. Jack thanks him and learns an important lesson: it is useful to know how to repair simple things.

exercises.question: Where does Jack want to go?
exercises.explanation: Jack decides to ride his bicycle to the park.

exercises.question: What is wrong with the bicycle?
exercises.explanation: Jack discovers that the bicycle chain has come off.

exercises.question: Jack fixes the bicycle without any help.
exercises.explanation: An older man helps Jack put the chain back in place.

exercises.question: What lesson does Jack learn?
exercises.answer: It is useful to know how to repair simple things.
exercises.explanation: The story ends by explaining the value of learning simple repair skills.

stories.title: رِحْلَةٌ إِلَى الْمَكْتَبَةِ
stories.text: قَرَّرَتْ مَرْيَمُ أَنْ تَزُورَ مَكْتَبَةَ الْمَدِينَةِ فِي عُطْلَةِ نِهَايَةِ الْأُسْبُوعِ. كَانَتْ تُحِبُّ الْقِرَاءَةَ، وَخَاصَّةً الْكُتُبَ الَّتِي تَتَحَدَّثُ عَنِ الْعُلُومِ وَالْفَضَاءِ. عِنْدَمَا وَصَلَتْ، اسْتَقْبَلَهَا أَمِينُ الْمَكْتَبَةِ وَدَلَّهَا عَلَى قِسْمِ كُتُبِ الْأَطْفَالِ. اخْتَارَتْ مَرْيَمُ كِتَابًا عَنِ الْكَوَاكِبِ، وَجَلَسَتْ تَقْرَؤُهُ بِاهْتِمَامٍ. تَعَلَّمَتْ أَنَّ الْمَشْتَرِيَ أَكْبَرُ كَوَاكِبِ الْمَجْمُوعَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ. قَبْلَ أَنْ تُغَادِرَ، اسْتَعَارَتِ الْكِتَابَ لِتُكْمِلَ قِرَاءَتَهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ.

vocabulary.meaning: مَكَانٌ تَجْتَمِعُ فِيهِ الْكُتُبُ لِلْقِرَاءَةِ وَالِاسْتِعَارَةِ
الشَّخْصُ الْمَسْؤُولُ عَنْ تَنْظِيمِ الْمَكْتَبَةِ وَكُتُبِهَا
الْحَيِّزُ الْوَاسِعُ الَّذِي تَقَعُ فِيهِ الْكَوَاكِبُ وَالنُّجُومُ

exercises.question: مَتَى زَارَتْ مَرْيَمُ الْمَكْتَبَةَ؟
exercises.explanation: ذَكَرَ النَّصُّ أَنَّ مَرْيَمَ قَرَّرَتْ زِيَارَةَ الْمَكْتَبَةِ فِي عُطْلَةِ نِهَايَةِ الْأُسْبُوعِ.

exercises.question: عَنْ أَيِّ مَوْضُوعٍ كَانَ الْكِتَابُ الَّذِي اخْتَارَتْهُ؟
exercises.explanation: اخْتَارَتْ مَرْيَمُ كِتَابًا يَتَحَدَّثُ عَنِ الْكَوَاكِبِ.

exercises.question: الْمُشْتَرِي هُوَ أَكْبَرُ كَوَاكِبِ الْمَجْمُوعَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ.
exercises.explanation: تَعَلَّمَتْ مَرْيَمُ هَذِهِ الْمَعْلُومَةَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ.

exercises.question: لِمَاذَا اسْتَعَارَتْ مَرْيَمُ الْكِتَابَ؟
exercises.explanation: أَرَادَتْ مَرْيَمُ مُوَاصَلَةَ قِرَاءَةِ الْكِتَابِ بَعْدَ مُغَادَرَةِ الْمَكْتَبَةِ.

image.alt: طَالِبَةٌ تَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا عَنِ الْكَوَاكِبِ فِي مَكْتَبَةٍ حَدِيثَةٍ

stories.title: A Rainy Day
stories.text: It is Saturday morning, and dark clouds cover the sky. Emma wants to play outside, but soon it starts to rain. She feels disappointed because she has planned a picnic with her family. Her mother suggests making a small indoor picnic instead. They prepare sandwiches, fruit, and fresh juice. Then they spread a blanket on the living room floor. Emma's father tells funny stories while everyone eats. Emma realizes that a rainy day can also be full of happiness.

exercises.question: What does Emma want to do?
exercises.explanation: The story says Emma wants to play outside.

exercises.question: What does her mother suggest?
exercises.explanation: Her mother suggests having a picnic inside the house.

exercises.question: Emma's family eats sandwiches and fruit.
exercises.explanation: The family prepares sandwiches, fruit, and fresh juice.

exercises.question: What does Emma learn at the end?
exercises.answer: A rainy day can also be full of happiness.
exercises.explanation: The family enjoys their indoor picnic despite the rain.
